revisionModel.checkedInRuntimeRevision: Task.updatedAt timestamp in Prisma Task schema; there is no Task.version column.

entrypointMatrix.entry: Tasks page / Kanban task editor save
entrypointMatrix.payloadRevision: No expectedUpdatedAt/baseUpdatedAt included; editor passes data only.
entrypointMatrix.serverPath: tasks.js:231-312: task read then whitelist; fields/status/assignee split; transaction invokes three task commands without cas; ordinary audit after transaction.
entrypointMatrix.staleSemantics: No client-baseline rejection; history confirms stale title PUT can return 200 and overwrite newer value.

entrypointMatrix.entry: Tasks page online status action / Kanban online drag
entrypointMatrix.serverPath: tasks.js:316-347: reads task for authorization/status side effects then direct prisma.task.update by id; no conditional updatedAt predicate.
entrypointMatrix.offlineCounterpart: Both current UI paths enqueue status with task.updatedAt as baseUpdatedAt.
entrypointMatrix.staleSemantics: Online and offline status actions have different revision contracts; per-status concurrency result was not dynamically tested.

entrypointMatrix.entry: Generic offline task upsert: ordinary fields
entrypointMatrix.payloadRevision: SyncChange has optional baseUpdatedAt; current first-party offline task queue call sites found only status actions, not ordinary editor fields.
entrypointMatrix.serverPath: sync.js:69-87 task registry field list; 424-435 stale precheck; 464-490 task commands inside transaction.
entrypointMatrix.staleSemantics: When base is absent, server CAS compares against the timestamp it just read, which protects the read-to-write race but does not detect that the client edited an already-stale cached revision. When base is present and stale, returns conflict; subsequent CAS protects concurrent change after read.

entrypointMatrix.method: HTTP PUT field or generic sync tasks upsert
entrypointMatrix.payloadRevision: HTTP PUT no baseline. Generic sync can carry baseUpdatedAt, but no first-party offline enqueueChange assignment caller was found.
entrypointMatrix.serverPath: tasks.js:251-252,291-293 calls assignTask without cas; sync.js:467-488 passes observed CAS on first transaction write when there is a task update and supplied base is not stale.
entrypointMatrix.staleSemantics: Route-level action authorization exists; revision parity absent online. Generic sync conditional on optional client base. Supported external/legacy sender set unknown.

entrypointMatrix.entry: Mixed ordinary fields + status + assignee in one PUT
entrypointMatrix.payloadRevision: No client baseline in DTO or route.
entrypointMatrix.serverPath: All effective subcommands share one Prisma transaction (tasks.js:282-295), but none receives cas; transaction gives all-or-none composition, not stale-client rejection.
entrypointMatrix.staleSemantics: A mixed stale body can still be applied as a transaction; historical B16 evidence proves title path, not every mixed field combination.

entrypointMatrix.entry: Mixed ordinary fields + status + assignee in sync task upsert
entrypointMatrix.payloadRevision: One optional baseUpdatedAt applies to whole command; not per-field.
entrypointMatrix.serverPath: Task update decomposes fields/status/assignee and passes cas once on the first actual command within one Prisma transaction.
entrypointMatrix.staleSemantics: When a base is present and stale before write, returns conflict. No base retains old-client stale overwrite exposure. A midflight race after read is guarded by observed timestamp CAS.

entrypointMatrix.payloadRevision: Neither route accepts/enforces client revision; sync explicitly excludes delete from stale-base precheck.
entrypointMatrix.serverPath: sync.js:429-448 updates tombstone by id; HTTP delete is separate cascade/soft-delete path.
entrypointMatrix.staleSemantics: Not resolved here; stale-delete/delete-wins policy is S03-OI-05 and only gates work changing that behavior. No dynamic stale-delete test run.
